sessions.phase_label: Deployment, link configuration, and CTA finalization

requirements.title: Lively Kids and Restaurant Imagery
requirements.definition: The landing page should use attractive, product-relevant imagery that creates a lively atmosphere involving children and restaurants.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested product pictures, replacement of the first images, and lively kids-and-restaurant atmosphere are treated as constraints of one visual-imagery behavior. The unspecified reference design does not establish a separately evolving layout Requirement.

requirements.title: Shareable Working Landing Page Link
requirements.definition: The completed landing page should be deployed at a working URL that the client can send directly to selected prospective customers so they can view the product page.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers deployment and successful page access through a shareable link, not access control. Hosting platform, custom-domain availability, and URL naming are treated as configuration attributes of this delivery mechanism.

requirements.title: CTA Redirect to Facebook
requirements.definition: The landing page's call-to-action button should redirect visitors to the Facebook page specified by the client.
requirements.boundary_note: CTA destination behavior can be configured, implemented, and tested independently of page hosting and visual design. The earlier uncertainty about destination is part of this Requirement's lifecycle.

requirements.title: Urgent Landing Page Delivery
requirements.definition: The freelancer should complete and deliver the working landing page on the client's urgent same-day timeline.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a bounded delivery obligation rather than a persistent product behavior; ordinary scheduling and status messages are not part of the Requirement unless they establish or change the delivery constraint.

unresolved_candidates.description: A contact form was proposed and discussed, but the client did not clearly accept it or specify its behavior. The evidence is insufficient to establish a standalone contact-form Requirement.

The exchange may concern a desired branded URL or page title, but it is unclear whether the client independently required a particular URL name. It is provisionally treated as an attribute or ambiguity of the shareable-link Requirement.
